protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed from the 9.5.0 tree and current GHSA/CVE/vendor records: action_view_express_entity accepts attacker-controlled exEntryID, resolves it with Doctrine find(Entry::class, $exEntryID), and renders the entry after only a same-entity comparison. The list emits sequential Entry::getId() values. There is no per-entry view authorization, enabling enumeration and disclosure of Express submissions.
